verdict.rationale: Bolt documents creating a new GitHub repository from a project and syncing commits, so the full code and its change history live outside Bolt. That is a real export path for the source. The stack is standard npm/Vite/Next.js/Node, so the exported code is plausibly portable, and a community report describes a Bolt-built app launched on Vercel. Missing for 10: documented direct download/ZIP export, first-party docs on running locally or hosting on a third-party platform, independent corroboration that exported projects run cleanly outside Bolt.
